notes.title: Little Stories
notes.content:
Hi everyone! It's been awhile since the release, and we're glad to present you an update for our game, The Little Stories.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37759893/3cc293a224920122ced15fed0b0b3dcafc5e0f7e.png[/img]

Finishing the game now unlocks 3 new levels. Each level is a short story that takes place after the main plot events.
Right now, we're experimenting and testing things out to create new levels. That's why these short stories may seem unusual in contrast with the main game.
We'll be happy to hear player feedback from you on the [url=https://discord.gg/unJYSRQVh2 ]Discord[/url] server or on the Steam community page.

In addition, we fixed the following bugs:
- Player character no longer throws out items at the start of a dialogue or a cut-scene
- Fixed the camera focus issue that occured during boss battles (multiplayer)
- The screen size option now sets the refresh rate to max automatically

notes.title: Achievements
notes.content:
Hi, everyone! 
Launch day is right around the corner, and so we’re adding the finishing touches to our game.

[h2]Achievements[/h2]
We’ve added multiple achievements that will add a bit of flair to your adventure. Some are simple, some not so much. Currently there’s 12 you can obtain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37759893/949e63d3c13a9b80fe01e6d0f0dd46902fd67553.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37759893/4767fcf5d68a73413a1828ae4b08e2df21882816.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37759893/18a7650266b991fae8d113d78299c0d15ea8bcbd.png[/img]

[h2]Music and Sounds[/h2]
We’ve added and changed a bunch of stuff, but most importantly:
- Added new music for the first boss fight. Now it sounds more unique, like the other boss encounters. 
- Added enemy sounds for when they spot the player character. Unique to each enemy.
- Added sounds for the menu buttons, makes it nicer :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37759893/7387bde42b4d38e14169aeaa152925f1faa35117.gif[/img]

notes.title: Little joys
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
Today, we're going to share some small, yet significant improvements in our game.

[h1]New Demo[/h1]
We've updated the demo - fixed the bugs, added new features, updated the localization, etc. Currently, we're participating in Steam's Next Fest! We are grateful to all those who have played and wishlisted the game.
https://store.steampowered.com/sale/nextfest 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37759893/2841aff9db21df045a149b29f88461a914f118de.gif[/img]

[h1]Gamepads[/h1]
The game now supports controller input for PS5, PS4, Nintendo Pro, and Xbox gamepads (a big shoutout to our talented programmer!). Additionally, we'd like to remind you that if you don't like the default controller layout, you can customize it in the Settings menu. Play the way that suits you best!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37759893/78fb398e1521560bbee4fa0a571e9e41aa5e9b25.jpg[/img]

[h1]Localization[/h1]
The game is available in Russian and English. We have devoted significant time and effort to perfecting the English localization, and we are excited for the global audience to experience the results!

We plan to add more languages in the future, and we're seeking feedback from our players to help us decide which ones to include.

Until next time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37759893/0ac115e0507744655dd59766f7e7e51048f2dcfb.gif[/img]

notes.title: Co-op!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Today we're going to tell you more about the co-op!

Now Undercat supports local two-player co-op.
It also supports Steam's Remote Play Together feature.

There are two modes available.
1. Main campaign co-op.
2. PvP matches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37759893/20ed19f3558fea401da3b4d7ef997cec3b1d5b84.gif[/img]

[h2]Main campaign co-op[/h2]
Through the main menu, invite your friend to play the main campaign with at any time. This opens new opportunities for you as you complete the levels! 
Use your friend's character as a platform to jump higher, toss them to unlock new paths, or hurl them as a projectile to stun your enemies.

Share inventory slots, money, and  respawn points.
Have fun and wreak havoc!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37759893/3605e64092c996ba43a85378b8275e1765d9dfc3.gif[/img]

[h2]PvP matches[/h2]
This is a separate game mode. Here, you and your friend complete a series of levels with special victory conditions. The player that completes the level first gets a star. The winner is defined at the end of the level series.
There are 5 kinds of matches - Combat, Racing, Marking, Searching, and All Modes.

Just like in the main campaign, you can grab, shake, and toss your friend! Don't miss your chance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37759893/f739815f3d1d49751c630e09bf0c94f2b7f7527a.gif[/img]

[h2]A little bit of history[/h2]
We didn't plan for multiplayer at first.
But after we showed the game to our friends and showcased it at several big events, we realized we had to do it, because the most agreed-on feedback was, "I want to play this with my friend!"

We didn't expect this. We had considered adding multiplayer, but multiplayer required a different approach from the perspectives of both development and game design. So we moved this feature to our backlog, planning to bring it at a later stage, as a separate mode in one of the updates.
But the players were unanimous in the comment section, demanding, "We want co-op!"

A lot had to be redone. The development became more complex.
However, the multiplayer complemented the game perfectly. The players welcomed it, and the volume of positive feedback from the change grew exponentially.

notes.title: What we've been working on
notes.content:
Today we're going to share what has changed in the game itself.

[h2]New area[/h2]

In the demo, you have already saw a glimpse of two of the areas, Slums and Factories.

Slums are an unforgiving hotbed of bandits, teeming with dangerous bugs, with dirty water and extreme heat making bad things worse - all a result of the Cats' regime. However, this is exactly where the Rebellion movement has come to life. Our journey starts here. 

Factories are a place where all the animals toil away at the factories or the mines. Their lives are held fast under the Cats' thumb by the police.

Now we have added the final area, the Perfect Lands, the Cats' dream-come-true of a habitat, where they have all the lush greenery, clean air, and freedom they want... or so believes the general population. But there's something odd going on in this place...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37759893/564d9abc224dce8e9ec1039ddb0f327dbda7434f.gif[/img]

[h2]New PvP levels[/h2]

We have 4 PvP modes total, Combat, Race, Collect, Marking. We've added new levels, and now each mode has 5 maps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37759893/40735bc00413e6d7d4741eb1efa04060a7d53549.gif[/img]

[h2]Other changes and upgrades[/h2]

This is probably the biggest category yet. We're having a hard time remembering *every* single change, so we're going to focus in the most exciting ones:

[list]
[*] New inventory system. Now it can be used by two players in the co-op mode simultaneously.
[*] Intro dialogues on every level. More story and jokes!
[*] New bonus levels in each area.
[*] Tutorial improvements.
[*] Numerous changes of varying degree concerning the levels and the boss fights.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37759893/68a2662d01bfe09fd3c7163b144256273c62b96d.gif[/img]

This isn't everything that we've been working on - only what we are the most excited to share with you.

Thank you for staying with us!
